Color Blindness Simulator

See colors and images as color-blind viewers do.

Machado et al. (2009) matrices, full severity.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a color, or upload an image (PNG/JPG).
  2. The original and four simulations render side by side.
  3. Compare protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia and achromatopsia.
  4. All processing happens locally — nothing is uploaded.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which simulation model is used?

The matrices published by Machado, Oliveira and Fernandes (2009) at full severity: protanopia (no red cones), deuteranopia (no green cones), tritanopia (no blue cones) and achromatopsia (total color blindness).

Is the simulation medically exact?

No — it is a widely used approximation. Real color vision varies person to person, so treat the results as indicative, not clinical.

Color or image — which do I use?

Either: pick a color for a quick swatch test, or upload an image to see the whole picture transformed. Everything runs locally in your browser.
